section: 4 Algebraic renormalization of SUSY gauge theories with constant ghosts
title: An analysis of the cohomology structure of super Yang-Mills coupled to matter
claim: Formulates the Wess-Zumino consistency conditions for N=1 super Yang-Mills coupled to a chiral (Wess-Zumino) multiplet in components, in Wess-Zumino gauge with the auxiliary fields eliminated; the on-shell-closing SUSY+gauge algebra is closed by the Batalin-Vilkovisky construction (antifield-dependent terms) and the resulting local cohomology is computed with spectral sequences. The detailed list of cocycles could not be read (paper not on arXiv).
loop_order: all orders (cohomological statement; ghost numbers 0 and 1)
theory: N=1 SYM + chiral matter, components, Wess-Zumino gauge, no auxiliary fields
symmetry_argument: BV extended BRST differential with constant SUSY ghosts; local cohomology by spectral sequences

proved: (per INSPIRE abstract) BV closure of the on-shell SUSY+gauge algebra in WZ gauge and a spectral-sequence computation of the associated cohomology; the exact statements were not verified at equation level
assumed: implicit in any cohomological anomaly analysis: a renormalization scheme obeying the quantum action principle, so that breakings of the Slavnov-Taylor identity are local insertions satisfying the consistency condition (not verified in the text)

evidence: INSPIRE abstract of CQG 9 (1992) 1663: WZ gauge, auxiliary fields eliminated, 1983 BV formalism closes the algebra, cohomology solved via spectral sequences
cited as ref. [12] in Maggiore-Piguet-Wolf hep-th/9507045, which treats the same class of models
red_flags: full text not accessible (not on arXiv); no equation-level verification possible

Brandt hep-th/0212070 (Introduction) describes earlier SYM cohomology computations as done in restricted function spaces (power-counting / low ghost number); whether White's analysis is among the works meant there (refs [1,2] of Brandt) was not verified
cross_checks: consistent in setting with S4.03_MaggiorePiguetWolf1996 (only the supersymmetric extension of the gauge anomaly in the power-counting-renormalizable sector)
complete, unrestricted cohomology later in S4.11_Brandt2003 (hep-th/0212070)
source_access: abstract only (INSPIRE); secondary: cited in hep-th/9507045
notes: Lead verified: title and CQG 9 (1992) 1663 correct; no arXiv version exists.
